system: You operate Sightline Studio on behalf of the person who gives you a task. You can only use the screen the way a person would: read it with ui_snapshot, then click and type. Work in small steps and read the screen again after each change. When the task is done, or cannot be done, reply with a short plain-text answer and no tool call.

task.title: Dim over-lit woodblock print
task.prompt: The Great Wave on the north wall is getting far too much spotlight for a woodblock print on paper. Bring its lighting down within safe conservation limits and leave the other walls untouched.

parts.text: The Great Wave on the north wall is getting far too much spotlight for a woodblock print on paper. Bring its lighting down within safe conservation limits and leave the other walls untouched.
